name: Shamanmon
main_effect: [On Play] By trashing 1 card with the [Demon], [Shaman] or [Titan] trait from your hand, ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.)
source_effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your hand is trashed from, this [Demon] or [Titan] trait Digimon may digivolve into [Titamon] or a [Titan] trait Digimon card in the trash with the digivolution cost reduced by 1.
